title: A Self-Contained Proof of Proposition (1 - 1.67539) for the Twin Prime Problem
description: Self-contained proof of Proposition (1 - 1.67539) on twin primes (p + 2 = rq, r = 1 or prime, r <= q^{0.67539}) with a standalone pure-integer verifier at denominator 2^80, improving Li and Liu's (1 - 1.75).
notes: Standalone verifier: python verify_twin_upper_sieve_cert.py (Python 3.10+, standard library only).
